frontmatter.name: chore-rotator
frontmatter.description: Generate a fair chore rotation across household members, weighted by effort/age, with recurring task occurrences and reward credits tied to completion.

findings.title: allowed-tools does not list MCP tools the skill invokes
findings.evidence: allowed-tools: Read Write Edit (but body invokes orbrey:rewards.wallets, orbrey:tasks.list, tasks.set_status, tasks.delete_occurrence, tasks.create)
findings.fix: Add the MCP tool identifiers, e.g. allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, mcp__orbrey__rewards_wallets, mcp__orbrey__tasks_list, mcp__orbrey__tasks_set_status, mcp__orbrey__tasks_delete_occurrence

findings.title: allowed-tools uses space-separated format
findings.fix: Reformat as comma-separated: allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, ...

findings.title: Description could front-load discovery keywords
findings.evidence: Generate a fair chore rotation across household members, weighted by effort/age, with recurring task occurrences and reward credits tied to completion.
findings.fix: Prefix with trigger keywords such as 'Chore rotation, household tasks, allowance:' to improve search discovery.

findings.title: ultrathink directive in skill body has no defined effect
findings.fix: Remove the bare 'ultrathink' token; it is a slash-command keyword, not a skill-body directive.

findings.title: No reference.md for deeper detail
findings.evidence: SKILL.md hosts all rules/tables inline (173 lines).
findings.fix: At current size this is acceptable. If the skill grows past ~300 lines, extract age-band and effort-point tables and behavioural rules into reference.md.
